The handrail is dark polished wood, curving from the left foreground towards the right background. It is supported by numerous vertical metal balusters. Strong specular highlights from overhead recessed lighting reflect off the smooth surfaces of the rail and balusters. The background shows a warm-toned interior with wooden flooring and ceiling lights.
